post.description: Retrieve observations from any IMF dataflow (BOP current account, ER exchange rates, IL reserves, IMTS bilateral trade, CPI, GFS, FM, WEO) by dimension key. Codes are validated against the dataflow's availability; unknown codes fail with invalid_input listing valid ones. Observations carry source codes, unit, scale, status and dataset vintage; a valid key with no observations returns complete=true and no records.

key.description: Dimension -> codes. Dimension names follow the structure (COUNTRY, INDICATOR, FREQUENCY, COUNTERPART_COUNTRY, UNIT, ...); REF_AREA, FREQ and COUNTERPART_AREA are accepted aliases. Omitted dimensions are wildcards.

post.description: World Economic Outlook observations for one edition (2026-04 current, 2025-10, 2025-04, or `latest`), given WEO subject codes (NGDP_RPCH, PCPIPCH, LUR, GGXWDG_NGDP, BCA_NGDPD, ...) and ISO3 economy or WEO group codes. Every row carries the edition, publication date and is_estimate (year after LATEST_ACTUAL_ANNUAL_DATA), so two editions can be compared for revisions.

country_codes.description: ISO3 codes (USA, DEU) or WEO group codes (G001 World, G110 Advanced economies, G163 Euro area, G200 Emerging market and developing economies).

edition.description: YYYY-MM edition. Served now: 2026-04 (IMF.RES:WEO), 2025-10 (WEO_2025_OCT_VINTAGE), 2025-04 (IMF.RES:WEO 6.0.0). Other months map to WEO_YYYY_MON_VINTAGE and return not_found when the IMF has not published that vintage. Pattern: ^([0-9]{4}-(01|04|07|10)|latest|current)$.
